ruleIdVsTokenId: Rule ids here are t0/t2/t7/t11. Circuit NFT token ids are separate and must be discovered from the user's wallet. The published example circuit #2 carries rule t0 (36 gates, $9.21), NOT rule t2. Never hardcode a token id.
